title: Bessent ‘Inadvertently’ Failed to Report Holdings of JPMorgan Stock
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s finances were reviewed by the inspector general after Mr. Bessent incorrectly listed at least $100,000 of the stock, which was owned by his husband, as cash.
